content: If DemDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE and any Dem API ex- cluding : • Dem_SetEventStatus • Dem_ResetEventStatus • Dem_SetEventAvailable • Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus • Dem_GetVersionInfo • Dem_MainFunction • Dem_SetEventFailedWithSyncFreezeFrame is called before Dem has been fully initialized, the Dem module shall set the error code DEM_E_UNINIT .
